scope: Seven pre-registered instrument datasets spanning equity indices, FX, crypto spot, commodity spot, and adjusted bond/equity ETFs. Excluded datasets remain listed with explicit reasons; this is not universal market coverage.
family_policy: All seven candidate datasets must pass provider, schema, corporate-action, and minimum-sample gates. If any candidate is unavailable or fails a prerequisite, no family-level confirmatory conclusion is issued.
pre_registered_hypothesis: For each instrument, the fixed close-only GBM probability model has positive Brier Skill versus its causal rolling empirical baseline on the untouched holdout.
primary_metric: Brier Skill = 1 - model multiclass Brier / causal baseline multiclass Brier

acceptance_criteria.confidence_interval: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap interval for paired Brier Skill
acceptance_criteria.multiple_testing: Holm family-wise adjustment across all seven pre-registered instruments
acceptance_criteria.instrument_pass: 95% CI lower bound > 0 and Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p-value < 0.05
acceptance_criteria.family_pass: All seven instruments pass; otherwise family result is not confirmed
acceptance_criteria.missing_data_rule: No instrument is silently dropped or replaced after holdout begins; any missing/failed dataset makes the family incomplete.

frozen_model_configuration.baseline: rolling empirical frequencies of fully matured prior barrier outcomes
frozen_model_configuration.calibration: causal convex blend on matured prior forecasts; fixed existing implementation

data_rules.training_history_before_holdout: Allowed only as historical model-estimation and matured-calibration input.
data_rules.outcome_maturity: Only forecasts whose full five-observation outcome horizon is present are scored.
data_rules.no_repair: No interpolation, sorting, filling, resampling, or retroactive manual corrections.
data_rules.provenance: Record provider, retrieval URL without credentials, raw-source SHA-256, canonical-data SHA-256, row count, first/last timestamps, manifest, and audit results.
data_rules.corporate_actions: ETF candidates require exact event-date and dividend/split amount/ratio reconciliation between Yahoo and EODHD; unmatched/unavailable audit blocks the family.
data_rules.futures: Continuous vendor futures series is excluded until contract-level constituents, declared roll rule, overlapping roll observations, and adjustment method pass the futures roll audit.
data_rules.calendar: Timezone and calendar declarations are frozen; exchange session/holiday semantics remain a stated limitation until independently audited.
